_comment: Known feature-E2E failures. Each entry: { case, gap, reason }. Shrink-only: a new failure fails CI, and an entry whose case now passes must be removed in the same change.

company-master.reason: The executable T02 case opens /masters/companies and requires the desktop New action plus editable identity fields; the current milestone intentionally exposes only a read-only Code/Name list, so the rich identity workflow remains missing under G38/N58.

sales-order.reason: The scheme amount is read-only on the order. The Lite desktop types it (TR_SALE_ORD.cs:11264-11290) and adds it to the advance (:11368), but its day-book row, type 05 to the fixed account 00079 (Ac_Rojmel.cs:19), is absent from the real data for the 7 of 76 orders that carry a scheme amount (web/docs/PLAN-SALESORDER-ROJMEL.md section 2.4); building it would add rows the desktop's data does not have. Old gold and old silver are taken since this change.

data-backup.reason: The real v2 archive has no versioned tenantConfig section or allowlist because D-BKP-3 has not approved the NextMain-equivalent configuration and credential envelope.

data-refresh.reason: The existing Data Repair routes are admin-only, but the owner-decided Data Refresh caption FRM_PRINT handoff remains active-owned work.
The browser stack has no approved synchronization hook at the repair lock; parallel previews do not prove the required voucher-save/apply race.
The full Ac_Ledr, Ac_Rojmel and Ac_Tax builder graph is unproved; Account is explicitly preview-only.
The remaining StockRefresh and Ac_Stock builder graph is unproved; Stock is explicitly preview-only.
Field Update awaits PR-2 statement-by-statement classification under D-REF-3.
Old Field awaits PR-2 statement-by-statement classification under D-REF-3.
Legacy MOB_IMAGE, IMG_IMPORT and CONV_IMAGE semantics and byte migration are unproved.

purchase-report.reason: Purchase Rpt (RP_ALL.cs:6656-6707, MDI_FORM.cs:8911-8920) has no dedicated screen yet: the Reports navigation offers no Purchase Rpt link. The shared RP_ALL selector, filter and grouping engine comes first with the Sales Report (prompt 01); this frozen case then turns green and its entry is removed.
